messages:
maria_cs: :wave: Heads-up — Candela week0 private/VPC onboarding health check. Quick summary: three blockers preventing go-live: 1) outbound egress rules (telemetry + model artifact fetch), 2) KMS key policy doesn't include Redwood principal so we can't migrate secrets, 3) service-account / IAM role missing runtime decrypt & S3-read. Also calling out renewal risk: they're month-to-month and expect go-live this week; if we miss next billing they'll push pause. Can infra/security/platform weigh in? Link to runbook: https://redwood.run/runbooks/priv-onboard

liyuan_se: Which outbound ranges do we need to allow? want to avoid opening wide subnets if possible.

maria_cs: They provided two ranges: telemetry -> 52.24.0.0/16, model artifacts -> 18.200.0.0/16. Paste of what they gave: 
```
# Customer suggested egress CIDRs
- allow 52.24.0.0/16 TCP 443 -> telemetry.collector.redwood.internal
- allow 18.200.0.0/16 TCP 443 -> artifacts.s3.redwood-models
```

alex_ops: I can add the SG/NACL entries and update their route table tomorrow morning. Question: do they want NAT gateway egress or egress proxy? NAT is easier but no visibility.

maria_cs: They prefer proxy for observability but will accept NAT for initial cut if we ship telemetry forwarder. I'll capture that in the runbook.

sam_platform: KMS note — current key policy only trusts cust-admin@candela. We need to be added as a principal for decrypt during the migration window. Also their rotation is 90d; recommend 365d until handoff. I'll draft key policy diff.

harper_security: Also we need audit logs streaming to their SIEM (Splunk). They haven't installed the log-forwarder. Recommend enabling audit export from CloudAudit -> PubSub -> their collector. If they insist on retention parity, we should confirm retention window.

deploy-bot: Deployment check: canary image smoke passed in staging, no auth errors. See CI: https://ci.redwood.run/builds/9921 :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Great. Actionable items for renewal slide: reduce first-week token spend with Optimize batching, confirm SLA targets (p90 < 150ms for embed flows), and schedule enablement. Customer asks go-live by EOB Tue. If infra can't complete egress/KMS by then, flag risk to AE.

liyuan_se: IAM snippet (suggested minimal permissions for runtime):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-models/*"}
  ]
}
```

alex_ops: Putting a TODO in my queue: add KMS principal + open egress CIDRs + confirm NAT vs proxy. ETA: tomorrow 10:00 PST.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll block Wed 09:00 PT for a 30m enablement + handoff call and add renewal owners. Also capturing customer feedback: they saw embedding latency spikes with long contexts; suggested batching & prefix caching — we should enable Optimize quick wins.

harper_security: One more — ensure key policy includes a condition restricting decrypt to the onboarding time window or use Grant with expiration, so we don't persist cross-account access forever.

alex_ops: :thumbsup: will use a temporary grant and rotate after cutover.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll update the runbook with these items and ping AE for renewal play. Thanks team — will follow up after firewall + kms patch.
